statusDetail: Quick Sheet now has a Tow / Shop Arrival Pack, and Quick Sheet plus Diagnostics no longer report Garage-note saves as successful when owner access blocks the write.
actionRequired: No action needed. On iPhone, open Quick Sheet and use Arrival from the bottom bar after starting or updating a roadside session.
summary: Added a Quick Sheet Tow / Shop Arrival Pack that combines the selected roadside plan, contact details, live checkpoints, and reference routes for a tow driver, counter, or service advisor. Promoted Arrival into the Quick Sheet iPhone bottom action bar and Global Search. Hardened Quick Sheet and Diagnostics Garage-note save flows so owner-auth write blocks show failure instead of false saved statuses.
visibleChange: Quick Sheet now has an Arrival handoff reachable from the iPhone bottom bar for tow/shop handoffs after a roadside event.
impactReason: It turns existing roadside contact and checkpoint state into a one-tap handoff and prevents confusing false save confirmations when owner access is locked.
